messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a tiny nsys + torch.prof smoke capture for the checklib branch? I'm seeing ~200-400MB extra GPU mem on batch=4 for the new sharding tweak. Need nsys trace + torch.prof with NVTX, and a flamegraph. Please capture seq_len=1024, tokens=8 warmup, 16 steps. Gzip and upload to s3://redwood-profiling/checklib/2176543210/ and ping here. TL;DR commands below.

kevin: I can do a run in ~30m on ded-infer-a. Will you want CUDA kernel symbols? Also: set env RK_CACHE_WARM=1 to exercise kv warmup.

maria: Yep include cuda symbols if possible. Small note: prefer `--capture-range=nvtx` so we don't get init noise.

kevin: Example capture I use:
```
nsys profile --output trace_checklib \
  --capture-range=nvtx --capture-range-end=nvtx --sample=cpu --force-overwrite \
  --trace=cuda,cudnn,nvtx \
  python -m tools.run_infer --model models/checklib:latest --batch 4 --seq_len 1024 --steps 16
```
Then run torch.profiler in the script with `record_shapes=True, with_stack=False, profile_memory=True, use_cuda=True` and emit `torch.profiler.export_chrome_trace('pt_trace.json')`.

sara: Upload perms: use the `perf-uploader` role or the internal upload helper `scripts/upload_profile.sh` — it will set ACLs. Also scrub logs with `scripts/scrub_profiling.py` before upload (removes prompt text / user ids).

perfbot: Please include run_metadata.json alongside artifacts (git_sha, branch, machine, cuda, driver). See perfbot.help for required keys. :robot_face:

kevin: Will gzip: `tar -cJf trace_checklib.tar.xz trace_checklib.nsys pt_trace.json run_metadata.json` — if >200MB I'll split with `split -b 200M` and upload parts.

josh: For flamegraphs, we prefer speedscope (.speedscope.json) or folded stack via `flamegraph.pl` -> `flamegraph.svg`. If you need a quick command:
```
python -m torch.utils.bottleneck pt_trace.json > bottleneck.txt
# or convert chrome trace to folded stacks
scripts/trace_to_flame.sh pt_trace.json > folded.stacks
flamegraph.pl folded.stacks > flamegraph.svg
```

maria: Great — if you can timestamp and tag the s3 path with `checklib/<run>/<git_sha>` I'll pick this up within the hour. If anything OOMs, just grab `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` and attach.

kevin: On it. I'll post the upload link here when done. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks everyone — will do a quick triage and follow up with a 15-min sync if needed.
